channel.title: EGregoRA — The Podcast
channel.description: EGregoRA — an ornate house of enquiry co-founded by Edward Gregory and Jim Rankin, braiding cosmic physics, natural philosophy, astrology, druidry, sacred geometry, neuroscience, biology and the Law of One into one living study of reality.

item.title: 003 — Entropic Brains: Psychedelics, Prediction and the Loosening of the Model
item.description: Predictive processing, the default mode network, and what the visionary state actually does to the machinery of perception. With a long caution on set, setting and law.

item.title: 002 — The Grove and the Particle Accelerator
item.description: Why druidry and high-energy physics are asking the same question in different dialects — pattern, persistence and the behaviour of energy under constraint.

item.title: 001 — What Is an Egregore? Building a Mind Out of Many Minds
item.description: Edward opens the order: thought-forms, group minds, the sociology of belief, and why naming a thing accurately is the first act of magic.
